events.text: An abandoned mine on the mountainside. The walls glitter darkly where the old miners gave up.

ok.log: Two days of digging. Two lumps of black iron, heavy as sin. A smith will love these.

fail.log: The tunnel groans and you run. You get out with one lump of black iron and a lot of dust.

choices.text: Leave it to the miners' ghosts

variants: A mine on the mountainside, long abandoned. Where the old miners gave up, the rock still glints black.

events.text: An old battlefield where the rain has washed up broken weapons. Among the rust, some iron is still black and sound.

effects.log: You fill a sack with black iron from blades nobody will ever claim. (A smith can use this.)
You bury them like the dead. It feels right.

variants: Rain has washed broken weapons up out of an old battlefield. Most is rust, but some of the iron is still black and sound.

events.text: A lake frozen so deep the ice is blue-green. Something pale glows under it.

choices.text: Break the ice and dive (Cold Jade)

ok.log: The cold nearly stops your heart. In your hand: a piece of cold jade that frosts the air around it.

fail.log: The cold drives you back out, empty-handed and shaking. Perhaps next winter.

choices.text: Watch the glow and move on

effects.log: Some treasures are for looking at.

variants: A lake frozen so deep the ice has turned blue-green. Far below, something pale is glowing.

events.text: A cave so cold your breath freezes in the air. The walls are veined with green.

choices.text: Chip out a piece of the cold jade (Cold Jade)

effects.log: Your hands are numb for a day. The jade never warms. (A smith can use this.)
The cold sharpens your mind like a whetstone.

variants: A cave so cold your breath hangs frozen in the air. Green veins run through the walls.

events.text: Last night a star fell beyond the hills. This morning half the province is looking for where it landed.

ok.log: You reach the crater before anyone else. At its heart, still warm, a lump of meteor iron.

fail.log: A sect got there first. They are carrying something heavy away, very fast.

choices.text: Let the sects fight over it

effects.log: Three sects fight over a hole in the ground. You buy noodles and watch.

events.text: Hunters speak of a great horned beast in the deep mountains, older than the villages, that no arrow has ever wounded.

choices.text: Track it into the deep mountains (Great Beast Horn, dangerous)

ok.log: Three days of tracking, one terrible hour. You come down the mountain with a great beast's horn on your back.

fail.deathCause: a great beast in the deep mountains
fail.log: It is older and cleverer than you. You escape, bleeding, and the beast keeps its horn.

events.text: Deep in the forest, under a cliff, lies a horn as long as your arm: shed by something you are glad you did not meet.

effects.log: It is heavy and still faintly warm. The smith will want to know where you found it. (A smith can use this.)
You leave it for whatever might come back for it.
